briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF L-001
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- water tower top: (-44, -145), roof
- office roof: (58, -38), roof
- workshop: (33, -116), indoor
- pump house: (-81, -108), indoor
- electrical room: (137, 127), indoor
- water tank: (-146, -112), outdoor
- east fence: (77, 50), outdoor
- fuel depot: (-9, 149), outdoor
- antenna mast: (-111, 139), outdoor
- south yard: (-148, 107), outdoor

Robots:
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 20 kg), camera. Endurance: 5100 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 6.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1320 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1200 s, including the return to its start.
- G2 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 17 kg), camera. Endurance: 4260 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1500 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 5 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2580 s, including the return to its start.
- D4 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1140 s, including the return to its start.
- D5 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1080 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Deliver the toolkit (8 kg) to east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg).
- T2: Collect a soil sample (3 kg) at antenna mast and keep it on board. Location: antenna mast. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 3 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 1980 s.
- T3: Deliver the replacement filter (11 kg) to electrical room. Location: electrical room. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 11 kg).
- T4: Collect a soil sample (3 kg) at south yard and keep it on board. Location: south yard. Duration: 120 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 3 kg).
- T5: Tighten the valve at water tank. Location: water tank. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T6: Run a thermal scan of east fence. Location: east fence. Duration: 210 s. Needs: thermal camera.
- T7: Deliver the cable reel (3 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 3 kg).
- T8: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at water tank and keep it on board. Location: water tank. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg).
- T9: Replace the filter cartridge at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 660 s.
- T10: Tighten the valve at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm. Can start only after T7 is finished.
- T11: Deliver the battery pack (14 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 14 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.
- T12: Tighten the valve at pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 840 s. Can start only after T15 is finished.
- T13: Collect a soil sample (2 kg) at south yard and keep it on board. Location: south yard. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 2 kg).
- T14: Deliver the toolkit (11 kg) to south yard. Location: south yard. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 11 kg).
- T15: Deliver the pressure gauge (13 kg) to pump house. Location: pump house. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 13 kg).
- T16: Inspect office roof with a camera. Location: office roof. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 3000 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: water tower top (-44, -145, a rooftop); office roof (58, -38, a rooftop); workshop (33, -116, indoors); pump house (-81, -108, indoors); electrical room (137, 127, indoors); water tank (-146, -112, outside); east fence (77, 50, outside); fuel depot (-9, 149, outside); antenna mast (-111, 139, outside); south yard (-148, 107, outside).

The fleet: G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 20 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 85 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 6.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 22 minutes of flight time, return trip included. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 7 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 20 minutes including the flight home. G2 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 17 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 71 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. D3 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 8.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 25 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 5 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 43 minutes including getting back. D4, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 8 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 19 minutes of flight time, return trip included. D5 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 8 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 18 minutes including the flight home.

Jobs:
(T1) East fence needs the toolkit, which weighs 8 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T2) Pick up a soil sample at antenna mast and keep it on board; it weighs 3 kg - that takes 3 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 33 minutes.
(T3) Get the replacement filter (11 kg) over to electrical room - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T4) Pick up a soil sample at south yard and keep it on board; it weighs 3 kg - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T5) Someone has to tighten the valve at water tank - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T6) Do a heat check over east fence - that takes 3.5 minutes on site.
(T7) Get the cable reel (3 kg) over to pump house - that takes 1 minute on site.
(T8) Pick up a soil sample at water tank and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T9) Swap the filter cartridge at pump house - that takes 3 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 11 minutes.
(T10) The valve at pump house needs tightening - that takes 2.5 minutes on site but only once the cable reel (T7) has arrived.
(T11) Get the battery pack (14 kg) over to pump house - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.
(T12) Someone has to tighten the valve at pump house - that takes 4.5 minutes on site but only once the pressure gauge (T15) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 14 minutes.
(T13) Pick up a soil sample at south yard and keep it on board; it weighs 2 kg - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T14) Get the toolkit (11 kg) over to south yard - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T15) Pump house needs the pressure gauge, which weighs 13 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T16) Have a look at office roof - that takes 2.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 50 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
